---
title: "Fulfill an Order"
description: "Prepare the items in an order to be sent to the customer."
---

Fulfilling an order reserves its items and prepares them to ship. You fulfill from an order's detail page in the Vendor Portal, choosing a stock location and the items to include.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the orders list">
    Go to **Orders** in the sidebar. The page lists the orders that include your products. Select the order you want to work on.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/fulfill-an-order/step-1.png" alt="Open the orders list" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open the order">
    Selecting a row opens the order's detail page, where you manage fulfillment, shipping, payments, and returns for your part of the order.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Review the order">
    The detail page shows the order's items, customer, payments, and fulfillment status. Work from here.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/fulfill-an-order/step-3.png" alt="Review the order" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Fulfill the items">
    In the **Unfulfilled Items** section, open the actions menu and choose **Fulfill items**. Choose the stock location to fulfill from, confirm the items and quantities, and optionally notify the customer. The items move to a fulfillment you can then ship.
  </Step>
</Steps>
